summary: USA Rare Earth, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) supplementing risk factor disclosures related to a previously announced merger agreement with SVRE Holdings Ltd. The filing provides updated audited financials for SVRE (2024-2025), pro forma combined statements, and associated risk factors. It does not announce new deal terms, price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisors. No management change or special situation event is triggered; the filing is a routine disclosure update. The merger was announced April 19, 2026, but this 8-K solely provides supplemental information.
